description: Second experimental prompt for the rest_api_explanation diagnostic. Explicitly targets exactly four sentences while preserving factual requirements. This is an experiment input only; it does not replace the original benchmark case in benchmarks/cases.json.
constraints: Keep the original case definition and scoring rules unchanged.
Use identical generation settings for every measured trial.
Treat this prompt as a separate experimental condition, not a benchmark case.
prompt: Explain REST APIs in exactly four complete sentences. Sentence 1 must state that REST stands for Representational State Transfer and API stands for Application Programming Interface. Sentence 2 must explain the purpose of a REST API and mention HTTP and resources. Sentence 3 must accurately explain statelessness. Sentence 4 must explain how the client and server communicate through requests and responses. Do not add a heading, bullet points, or any text outside these four sentences. Do not invent technical definitions.
